description: Read an existing e-invoice into structured JSON: ZUGFeRD/Factur-X PDF (base64), XRechnung or EN 16931 CII XML, or UBL 2.1 Invoice/CreditNote XML. Returns number, dates, seller, buyer, lines, VAT breakdown, totals, payment details and notes; amounts stay strings exactly as in the XML. Does not validate (use validate_einvoice). No authentication required. Keywords: E-Rechnung auslesen, XRechnung lesen, ZUGFeRD XML extrahieren, invoice parser.
name: parse_einvoice
